says: Scenario: A node on another host
Host A runs the swarm: the master and node-1, both controlled by host A's manager.
Host A gives host B an invitation: public facts only, no secret.
Host B's own manager starts its node from the invitation, provisions it from host B's vault, on host B's own management network.
remote-1 is part of the swarm, reached by name, but host A does not control it: it is outlined on the map.
A request from host A crosses to remote-1's repository: in as a bundle, out on its main.
remote-1 writes a note in its own repository: activity its replicas see.
Host B's manager stops remote-1, gracefully.
The swarm runs on: a request from host A to node-1 is still answered.
